content.text:
The whole site changed because the web font stopped loading.

In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` rule pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The folder is actually `site/fonts/`. The font file 404'd, so every page fell back to the system font. That changed text widths and layout everywhere.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. After that, all 12 visual tests pass (6 pages at desktop and phone size) and all 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't confirm which change introduced the typo. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
